# CraftUI Comprehensive LLM Specification & Reference

This document is a complete, dense technical specification of the CraftUI framework designed for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI code assistants, and automated coding agents.

---

## 1. Core Architecture

CraftUI combines:
1. **`.cui` DSL**: Declarative layout and UI tree compiled to Rust structs via `craftui-dsl` build macro or interpreted by `craftui-runtime` in dev mode.
2. **Reactive Rust Engine**: State and application logic live in Rust using fine-grained reactivity (`Scope`, `Signal`, `Computed`, `Effect`).
3. **Multi-backend Canvas Renderer**: Direct GPU rendering via `wgpu` / `vello` or CPU rendering via `tiny-skia`.

---

## 2. `.cui` Language Syntax & Grammar

### 2.1 File Structure
A `.cui` file defines components, imports, structs, and enums:

```cui
// Imports
import { Header, NavButton } from "components.cui"

// Record struct (e.g. for lists)
struct NoteItem {
    id: int,
    title: string,
    pinned: bool = false,
}

// Enum
enum FilterState {
    All,
    Active,
    Done,
}

// Exported Component
export component AppRoot {
    // In-out properties (read/write from Rust or parent)
    in-out property <string> app_title: "CraftUI App";
    in-out property <int> counter: 0;
    in-out property <bool> is_loading: false;

    // Internal private properties
    property <string> query: "";

    // Callbacks to Rust
    callback on_submit(string);
    callback on_refresh();

    // UI Tree
    Column {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background: Theme.background;
        padding: 16dp;
        gap: 12dp;

        Text {
            text: app_title;
            font_size: 24;
            font_weight: Bold;
            color: Theme.text_primary;
        }

        Row {
            gap: 8dp;
            align: Center;

            Button {
                text: "Increment";
                background: Theme.primary;
                foreground: Theme.on_primary;
                on_tap => { counter += 1; }
            }

            Button {
                text: "Refresh";
                background: Theme.surface_variant;
                foreground: Theme.text_primary;
                on_tap => { on_refresh(); }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 2.2 Property Types
- `int` (64-bit integer)
- `float` (f64 floating-point)
- `string` (UTF-8 string)
- `bool` (boolean `true` / `false`)
- `color` (hex string `#RRGGBB` / `#RRGGBBAA` or `Theme.<token>`)
- `length` (e.g., `16dp`, `100%`, `auto`)
- `[Type]` (Array/List of types)
- Custom defined `struct` or `enum`

### 2.3 Property Declarations
- `in-out property <type> name: default_value;` (Accessible and bindable from Rust)
- `property <type> name: default_value;` (Component-internal state)
- `callback name(param_type, ...);` (Callable from `.cui`, implemented in Rust)

### 2.4 Control Flow
#### Conditional Rendering (`if` / `else`)
```cui
if is_loading : Column {
    align: Center;
    justify: Center;
    Text { text: "Loading..."; color: Theme.text_secondary; }
} else : Column {
    Text { text: "Content loaded"; }
}
```

#### Repeating Loops (`for`)
```cui
for item in items : Row {
    gap: 8dp;
    Text { text: item.title; flex_grow: 1.0; }
    Button {
        text: "Delete";
        on_tap => { on_delete_item(item.id); }
    }
}
```

### 2.5 Two-Way Binding (`<=>`)
Use `<=>` to synchronize input widgets with properties:
```cui
TextInput {
    placeholder: "Search notes...";
    value <=> query;
}
```

---

## 3. Built-In Widget Reference

### 3.1 Layout Widgets
- **`Column`**: Vertical flexbox layout.
  - Properties: `gap`, `align` (`Start`, `Center`, `End`, `Stretch`), `justify` (`Start`, `Center`, `End`, `SpaceBetween`, `SpaceAround`, `SpaceEvenly`)
- **`Row`**: Horizontal flexbox layout.
  - Properties: `gap`, `align`, `justify`
- **`Stack`**: Overlapping layer container. Position children with `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`.
- **`Grid`**: Multi-column grid. Properties: `columns: 2;`, `gap`, `align`, `justify`.
- **`ScrollView`**: Scrollable viewport. Properties: `direction: Vertical;` or `Horizontal;`.
- **`SafeArea`**: Inset padding avoiding notches, system status bars, and home indicators.
- **`Spacer`**: Flexible space. Use `flex_grow: 1.0;` to push siblings.
- **`Divider`**: Separation line. Properties: `direction: Horizontal;`, `thickness: 1;`, `color: Theme.border;`.
- **`SplitPane`**: Resizable two-pane divider. Properties: `direction`, `ratio <=> split_val;`, `min_first`, `min_second`.

### 3.2 Basic Primitives
- **`Text`**: Text display.
  - Properties: `text`, `font_size`, `font_weight` (`Normal`, `Medium`, `SemiBold`, `Bold`), `color`, `max_lines`, `wrap`
- **`Button`**: Interactive tap target.
  - Properties: `text`, `background`, `foreground`, `border_radius`, `padding_x`, `padding_y`, `disabled`
  - Events: `on_tap => { ... }`
- **`TextInput`**: Single-line text input.
  - Properties: `value <=> prop;`, `placeholder`, `font_size`, `font_weight`, `disabled`
  - Events: `on_change(new_text) => { ... }`, `on_submit => { ... }`
- **`TextArea`**: Multi-line text input.
  - Properties: `value <=> prop;`, `placeholder`, `font_size`, `flex_grow: 1.0;`
- **`Checkbox`**: Binary toggle box.
  - Properties: `checked <=> is_checked;`, `label`
  - Events: `on_change => { ... }` (exposes local `checked: bool`)
- **`Switch`**: Slider toggle.
  - Properties: `checked <=> is_active;`
  - Events: `on_change => { ... }` (exposes local `checked: bool`)
- **`Slider`**: Numeric continuous slider.
  - Properties: `value <=> num_val;`, `min: 0.0;`, `max: 100.0;`, `label`
  - Events: `on_change => { ... }` (exposes local `value: float`)
- **`Icon`**: Vector SVG icon.
  - Properties: `svg: "edit";` (or icon name), `size: 24;`, `color: Theme.text_primary;`
- **`Image`**: Bitmap image.
  - Properties: `source: "path.png";`, `width`, `height`, `fit: Cover;`
- **`Canvas`**: Custom drawing surface.
  - Properties: `on_paint => { ... }`, `on_pointer => { ... }`

### 3.3 Panels & Overlays
- **`Card`**: Elevated surface card.
  - Properties: `variant: Elevated;` (or `Filled`, `Outlined`), `background`, `border_radius`
- **`Modal`**: Center dialog overlay.
  - Properties: `open <=> is_modal_open;`, `title: "Confirm";`
- **`BottomSheet`**: Mobile slide-up sheet.
  - Properties: `open <=> is_sheet_open;`
- **`ToastHost`**: Toast notification overlay container.
- **`VirtualList`**: High-performance windowed recycling list for 10,000+ items.
- **`DataTable`**: Tabular data display with sorting and selection.

---

## 4. Common Layout & Styling Properties

Every widget accepts common layout properties:
- **Dimensions**: `width: 100%;`, `width: 300dp;`, `height: auto;`, `min_width: 0dp;`, `min_height: 0dp;`, `max_width: 720dp;`
- **Padding & Margin**: `padding: 16dp;`, `padding_x: 12dp;`, `padding_y: 8dp;`, `margin: 10dp;`
- **Flexbox**: `flex_grow: 1.0;`, `flex_shrink: 1.0;`, `flex_basis: 0dp;`
- **Appearance**: `background: Theme.surface;`, `border_radius: 8dp;`, `border_color: Theme.border;`, `border_width: 1dp;`, `opacity: 0.9;`, `visible: true;`
- **Tailwind Utility Classes**: `class: "bg-[#0E2938] text-white rounded-lg p-4 shadow-md";`

---

## 5. Built-In Theme Tokens

Always prefer Theme tokens over hardcoded colors for dark/light mode consistency:
- `Theme.background`: Main screen background.
- `Theme.surface`: Surface for cards, dialogs, and panels.
- `Theme.surface_variant`: Slightly contrasting surface (inputs, secondary buttons).
- `Theme.primary`: Main brand accent color.
- `Theme.on_primary`: Text/icon color drawn on top of `Theme.primary`.
- `Theme.text_primary`: High-emphasis text.
- `Theme.text_secondary`: Medium-emphasis text (subtitles, placeholders).
- `Theme.border`: Outlines and divider borders.
- `Theme.danger`: Error, warning, and destructive actions.
- `Theme.on_error`: Text/icon color drawn on top of `Theme.danger`.

---

## 6. Rust Reactivity & Controller Integration

### 6.1 Creating State & Signals
```rust
use craftui::prelude::*;

// In a setup function or App controller
let cx = Scope::root();

// Reactive signals
let count = cx.signal(0);
let title = cx.signal(String::from("My Note"));

// Computed derived values
let doubled = cx.computed(move || count.get() * 2);

// Effects for side effects / persistence
cx.effect(move || {
    println!("Current count: {}", count.get());
});
```

### 6.2 Mounting the `.cui` Component
When compiling `ui/app.cui` with component `AppRoot`:
`build.rs` generates Rust code providing `AppRootScreen::new(cx)`.

```rust
use craftui::prelude::*;
use crate::model::MyData;

pub fn mount_app(cx: Scope, tree: &mut WidgetTree) -> NodeId {
    let screen = AppRootScreen::new(cx);

    // Bind Rust signals to screen properties
    let count_signal = cx.signal(0);
    screen.counter.bind(count_signal);

    // Handle callbacks
    screen.on_submit.set(cx, move |query: String| {
        println!("User submitted: {}", query);
    });

    screen.root_node()
}
```

---

## 7. Anti-Hallucination Rules for AI

When generating CraftUI code:
1. **Never generate HTML / JSX tags**: `<div className="...">`, `<button onClick={...}>` do NOT exist.
2. **Never generate Flutter code**: `Scaffold(body: ...)` does NOT exist.
3. **Always use exact `.cui` types**: `int`, `float`, `string`, `bool`, `color`, `length`.
4. **Always use exact event names**: `on_tap`, `on_change`, `on_toggle`, `on_submit`.
5. **Layout container orientation**: Use `Column` for vertical, `Row` for horizontal. Do not write `flex-direction`.
6. **Semicolon requirement**: Every property line inside a widget block must end with `;`.
